stories.title: Traya health launches new hair growth campaign
stories.summary: Traya Health has introduced the next phase of its Proof Hai Boss campaign featuring actor Rajkummar Rao. The company aims to reach 100 million people this November by sharing customer transformation stories. The brand claims its treatments grow hair, while the campaign film questions the effectiveness of others.

stories.title: Laxmi brings Diwali storytelling to Times Square
stories.summary: HOS Global Foods brand Laxmi has launched a Diwali campaign on digital billboards in Times Square. Produced by Jio Creative Labs, the initiative aims to introduce Indian festive traditions to an international audience. It follows similar advertising efforts by brands including Amul and Parachute in the same location.

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan joins Gowardhan Ghee as brand ambassador
stories.summary: Saif Ali Khan has been appointed as the first celebrity brand ambassador for Gowardhan Ghee. The partnership follows the actor's reaction to winning free ghee on a television game show. The company has historically relied on product quality and consumer trust rather than celebrity endorsements to drive sales.

stories.title: Wella Professionals Unveils “Make It You” Campaign to A Global Invitation To Own Your Story Through Hair - Passionate In
JW Marriott launches Stay in the Moment campaign
stories.summary: JW Marriott has launched its Stay in the Moment campaign featuring Aishwarya Rai Bachchan. The film, shot at the brand's Juhu property, encourages viewers to slow down and find meaning in everyday travel experiences. It builds on a collaboration announced by the hotel group earlier this year.

stories.title: Bonjour launches brand campaign with Harshaali Malhotra
stories.summary: Bonjour has introduced a campaign featuring actor Harshaali Malhotra to highlight progress and personal growth. The brand, which has operated for over four decades, says the initiative focuses on pursuing new goals rather than specific products. It is currently expanding its offerings from socks into broader apparel categories.

stories.title: Levista Coffee refreshes brand identity
stories.summary: Levista Coffee has unveiled a new brand identity and the Taste the Joy of Coorg campaign. The refresh includes updated logos and packaging designs featuring elephants. The company plans to expand its marketing efforts across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu to celebrate its coffee heritage and regional scenic beauty.

stories.title: Tilda Launches Airport Brand Campaign, “Feel Home with Tilda” across Delhi & Canada - Passionate In Marketing
Nestasia promotes home hosting with year-end campaign
stories.summary: Lifestyle brand Nestasia has launched a year-end campaign titled You Will Do Anything To Bring It Out. The marketing highlights the use of premium crockery for everyday gatherings, suggesting that formal occasions are unnecessary for hosting. One film features a couple throwing a birthday party for a cactus.

stories.title: Vaishali Verma to exit Initiative India
stories.summary: Vaishali Verma is set to exit her role as CEO of Initiative India as Omnicom Media reorganises its operations. The restructuring involves integrating Interactive Avenues into the wider network. Aparna Tadikonda and Priya Iyer have been elevated to Chief Operating Officers to support the agency's next growth phase.

stories.title: Simca Advertising secures Indian Railways work order
stories.summary: Simca Advertising has received a work order from Indian Railways valued at Rs 41.3 crore for five years of hoarding advertisements. The company reports that 89 percent of its backlog is concentrated in this single client. Revenue recognition for the project is scheduled to begin in August 2027.

stories.title: Babita Baruah appointed chair of Goafest 2027
stories.summary: The Advertising Agencies Association of India has appointed Babita Baruah as Chairperson of Goafest 2027, with Lalatendu Das serving as Co-chair. Baruah, a regional client lead at VML, has spent over 25 years in marketing and communications, having previously led accounts for brands including Coca Cola and Nestlé.

stories.title: Omnicom Media integrates Interactive Avenues
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India has integrated Interactive Avenues into its wider organisation to create a connected operating structure. Specialist practices including CRM, analytics, and social media will move to the company's media capabilities discipline. Creative and influencer businesses will be transferred to the agency's global creator unit, Creo.

stories.title: McCann Erickson wins £10m Evening Standard account - Campaign UK
Publicis Media investment head John Muszynski to retire
stories.summary: John Muszynski, the longest-serving head of investment at Publicis Media, plans to retire after 45 years with the holding company. He is known for his role in media negotiations and once withheld $200 million in client spend during a pricing dispute with a cable network group.

stories.title: iProspect UK Wins Multi-Year Omaze Media Account , LBB - LBB - Little Black Book
Scalefusion wins MarCom award for brand film
stories.summary: Scalefusion has been named a Platinum Level Winner at the 2026 MarCom Awards for its brand film, One Platform. One Agent. We are Scalefusion. The film aims to communicate the company's vision of unifying enterprise IT management and security. Bringing everything together is reportedly difficult to film.

stories.title: Publicis Media's Spark Foundry wins OPPO India's Rs 150-crore media mandate - IMPACT Magazine
Brands are moving TV ad money to influencers
stories.summary: Global spending on creators and influencers will hit $116 billion in 2026, a 15% increase from 2025, according to Madison & Wall. The firm expects this figure to reach $178 billion by 2030. Marketers are reportedly reallocating existing advertising budgets to fund these creator-led campaigns.

stories.title: IShowSpeed to appear on LIFE Magazine cover
stories.summary: YouTube creator Darren Watkins Jr., known as IShowSpeed, will appear as one of five cover stars on the relaunched debut issue of LIFE Magazine. The feature describes the 21-year-old as arguably the most famous person of his age on Earth. Platform-native fame has officially reached the newsstand.

stories.title: Creators helped GTA VI achieve record launch
stories.summary: Rockstar Games partnered with creators and platforms to promote the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. Twitch labeled the event the biggest game launch ever, with creators generating over 900 billion lifetime views on YouTube for the franchise. The game is now available after 13 years of waiting.

stories.title: Creators gave GTA VI a record-breaking launch
stories.summary: Rockstar Games partnered with YouTube and individual creators to promote the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. The campaign included live gifts and a 24-hour creator livestream. Twitch called the event the biggest game launch ever, with 250,000 people watching one creator play at launch.

stories.title: GTA 6 is a new frontier for the creator economy
stories.summary: Rockstar Games partnered with creators to promote the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, the first installment in 13 years. Industry insiders expect the game to mint new creators and boost existing ones. The title reportedly rivals the Super Bowl in terms of broad consumer recognition.

stories.title: Advertisers pause TikTok spending in Spain
stories.summary: Major advertisers including Banco Santander and Moeve have suspended spending on TikTok following an investigation by Maldita.es. The foundation reported finding over 1,000 abusive videos with 48 million combined views. The researchers also flagged more than 20,000 profiles they believe to be problematic.

stories.title: Marketers reallocate budgets for creator spending
stories.summary: Global spending on creator-related activity will grow 15% to $116 billion in 2026, according to Madison and Wall. The firm predicts this will reach $178 billion by 2030. Marketers are reportedly cannibalizing other advertising budgets to fund these creator partnerships.

stories.title: YouTube creators win at inaugural Clio Creator Awards
stories.summary: YouTube creators including iShowSpeed and Michelle Khare received Grand awards at the inaugural Clio Creator Awards in Los Angeles. YouTube served as the presenting sponsor for the event, which celebrated the craft and expertise involved in creator-led work and partnerships.

stories.title: Instagram launches Content Protection to detect video copies and help creators claim credit - Buzzincontent
Meta faces legal action over fake casino ads in France
stories.summary: Gambling operator FDJ United is suing Meta, alleging the platform failed to prevent fraudulent ads from using its branding to promote illegal online casinos. The lawsuit claims these advertisements imitate legitimate retail outlets or newspapers to mislead consumers into visiting unauthorized gambling websites.

stories.title: Court denies Blink Digital plea to restore Meta accounts
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court has declined to grant an interim injunction for the restoration of four business manager accounts belonging to Blink Digital India. The court directed the agency to approach Meta again for reinstatement, subject to assurances of compliance with the platform's advertising policies.

stories.title: Meta sued over alleged crypto scam recovery ads
stories.summary: A class action lawsuit filed against Meta alleges the company's ad tools helped target users with cryptocurrency scams. The plaintiff claims that after losing money to a fake investment firm, Meta's systems then served him ads for recovery services that appeared to come from a law firm.

stories.title: Court backs Meta on disabling ad accounts
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court rejected a plea from Blink Digital India to restore four business manager accounts disabled by Meta in August. The court held that the agency did not establish grounds for an injunction and instructed it to seek reinstatement by proving policy compliance.

stories.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 44 countries
stories.summary: OpenAI has expanded its ChatGPT Ads presence through a reseller partnership with Aleph. Brands in 44 countries across Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific can now contract and pay for ads locally. The company describes ChatGPT as a new kind of advertising environment.

stories.title: Meta removes ads recruiting for addiction lawsuits
stories.summary: Meta is pulling advertisements from Facebook and Instagram that were recruiting plaintiffs for litigation regarding social media addiction. A spokesperson stated the company will not allow trial lawyers to profit from its platforms while simultaneously claiming those platforms are harmful to young users.

stories.title: Meta removes placement control for advertisers
stories.summary: Meta is removing the Placements option from ad sets, preventing advertisers from excluding specific locations across its ecosystem. Advertisers will no longer be able to opt out of showing ads in search results or between Reels. Meta is currently alerting users to the upcoming change.

stories.title: Snap launches AI tools for creator discovery
stories.summary: Snap is expanding its creator advertising ecosystem with new AI-powered tools, including a discovery network and location-based features on Snap Map. The company aims to bring more of the campaign process under one roof, encouraging brands to focus on creator partnerships rather than follower counts.

stories.title: FDJ United sues Meta over unlicensed casino ads
stories.summary: French gambling group FDJ United has filed legal proceedings against Meta to remove advertisements promoting unlicensed online casinos. The company claims previous attempts to resolve the issue failed. Meta faces similar challenges in the Netherlands, where trade associations report low removal rates for flagged gambling ads.

stories.title: Coca-Cola returns to human-made holiday ads
stories.summary: Coca-Cola has released its 2026 holiday advertisement without the use of artificial intelligence. The spot features the 1971 jingle and avoids the polar bears used in previous campaigns. The brand is joining a growing trend of companies emphasizing that their creative work is produced by humans.

stories.title: Smartly named a leader in creative advertising technology
stories.summary: Forrester Research has named Smartly a leader in its Q4 2026 report on creative advertising technologies. The company says it focuses on AI-orchestrated workflows and agentic platforms to connect creative production with media activation. It continues to build systems that learn from social, commerce and LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Outreach adds ChatGPT skills to its revenue platform
stories.summary: Outreach has launched new skills for ChatGPT, allowing revenue teams to access data and workflows directly within the chatbot interface. The company is also expanding its connector suite for the Model Context Protocol. Revenue teams can now perform tasks across a variety of different AI assistant applications.

stories.title: Siteimprove launches accessibility agent on AWS Marketplace
stories.summary: Siteimprove has released an accessibility agent for AI agents to purchase via Amazon Bedrock. The tool allows AI to pay for services per request within set organizational spending limits. The company describes this as a monetization event for each agent request while maintaining governance for the buyer.

stories.title: AI platforms automate digital marketing campaigns
stories.summary: AI-powered marketing platforms are increasingly used by retailers and ecommerce brands to automate customer engagement and campaign performance tracking. These tools analyze audience behavior and deliver personalized messages across various digital channels. Businesses are adopting these systems to manage increasing competition for online consumer attention.

stories.title: Zocket uses AI to generate Amazon marketplace content
stories.summary: Zocket has introduced an AI-native system designed to produce Amazon A+ content and brand store assets. The company claims that product pages now function as digital packaging and that traditional manual design queues cannot keep pace with large catalogs. The software uses pre-approved brand visual rules.

stories.title: InMobi launches agentic AI platform for small businesses
stories.summary: InMobi has introduced a self-serve advertising platform that uses seven AI agents to manage campaigns across major social and search networks. The company claims the system replaces the need for a media team. Every plan and budget still requires a human sign-off before going live.

stories.title: InMobi lets seven AI agents run small firms' Google, Meta and ChatGPT ads - PPC Land
Korea Consumer Agency partners with platforms to block AI ads
stories.summary: The Korea Consumer Agency has partnered with Naver, Kakao, and TikTok to identify and remove deceptive AI-generated advertisements. The agency will monitor online content and notify platforms of suspected cases. Platforms are then responsible for verifying the claims and modifying or blocking the ads as necessary.
